content.title: Sub-Area Planning: W. 64th Avenue
content.summary: In 2024 and 2025, the City conducted a sub-area planning effort for the W. 64th Avenue corridor, engaging residents through community open houses to gather feedback on necessary improvements, particularly for pedestrian and bicycle access. However, due to a shift in priorities towards a broader Comprehensive Plan for the entire city in 2026 and 2027, the City will incorporate the feedback received into this new plan instead of creating a separate W. 64th Avenue Sub-Area Plan. Improvements to the corridor, including traffic signal updates and sidewalk enhancements, are also underway.
content.body:
In 2024 and 2025, the City engaged in a sub-area planning effort for the W. 64th Avenue Sub-Area, which is generally defined as the area along W. 64th Avenue between Simms Street and Yank Way. The City hosted two community open houses, giving residents the opportunity to learn more about this sub-area planning effort and to provide their input to assist in developing the plan.

During these sessions, we gathered a lot of information and ideas from you. For example, you told us that pedestrian and bicycle improvements are needed along the full stretch of W. 64th Avenue from Ward Road to Simms Street, and maintaining the character of the retail in the area should be a priority. You can read a summary of the feedback we received below. Your input so far has been invaluable. 

## Winter 2026 update

While a third community open house was planned to further narrow down resident ideas and begin building the W. 64th Avenue Sub-Area Plan, the City's priorities and resources are shifting. Notably, the Comprehensive Plan — which will envision not only the W. 64th Avenue corridor, but the whole city — is taking place throughout 2026 and 2027.

In light of this change in direction, **the team will incorporate your feedback so far into the new Comprehensive Plan, rather than creating a dedicated W. 64th Avenue Sub-Area Plan**. All that residents have shared so far will be considered as the City looks at land use, development, transportation, parks and open spaces, emergency preparedness and resiliency. Read more about the Comprehensive Plan [on this webpage](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1374/2026-27-Comprehensive-Plan-Update).

Additionally, the City has completed or is planning improvements to travel along the W. 64th Avenue corridor, including traffic signal retiming and signal replacement and sidewalk improvements at the [intersection with Simms Street](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1085/64th-Simms-Intersection). Potential transit improvements along W. 64th Avenue are also prioritized in the [Transportation System Plan](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1309/Transportation-System-Plan).
